## All Tool Reviews (47 tools)

### AI Assistants
- ChatGPT — 4.5/5 — Most versatile AI assistant. $20/mo (≈₹1,860). Best for general use.
- Claude — 4.4/5 — Best writing quality. $20/mo (≈₹1,860). Best for prose and reasoning.
- Google Gemini — 3.8/5 — Best Google ecosystem integration. $20/mo (≈₹1,860). Best for Workspace users.
- Microsoft Copilot — 3.5/5 — Office 365 integration. $20/mo (≈₹1,860). Best for enterprise Microsoft users.
- Meta AI — 3.2/5 — Free via WhatsApp/Instagram. Best for zero-friction access.
- Mistral Le Chat — 3.4/5 — Privacy-first European alternative. Free. Best for GDPR-conscious users.

### Code Assistants
- Cursor — 4.5/5 — Best AI code editor. $20/mo (≈₹1,860). Best for multi-file refactoring.
- GitHub Copilot — 4.2/5 — Best value coding assistant. $10/mo (≈₹930). Best for VS Code users.
- Windsurf — 3.8/5 — Best free AI coding tool. Free unlimited autocomplete. Best for budget developers.
- Claude Code — 3.9/5 — Terminal-based agent. Requires Claude Max $100/mo (≈₹9,300). Best for complex codebase tasks.
- Amazon Q Developer — 3.1/5 — AWS-specific. Free tier available. Best for AWS developers only.
- Tabnine — 3.0/5 — Privacy-focused. $12/mo (≈₹1,116). Declining relevance.

### Writing & Content
- Grammarly — 4.0/5 — Best integrated writing assistant. $12/yr (≈₹1,116/yr). Best for email writers.
- Jasper — 3.6/5 — Marketing-focused writing. $49/mo (≈₹4,557). Best for marketing teams.
- Copy.ai — 3.4/5 — Budget marketing AI. $29/mo (≈₹2,697). Acceptable for short-form.
- Writesonic — 3.5/5 — SEO-focused writing. $19/mo (≈₹1,767). Trial only, no real free tier.
- Rytr — 3.0/5 — Budget writing tool. $9/mo (≈₹837). Lowest quality but cheapest.

### Image Generation
- Midjourney — 4.4/5 — Highest image quality. $10/mo (≈₹930). No free tier.
- DALL-E 3 — 4.1/5 — Best ease of use via ChatGPT. Free via ChatGPT. Best for beginners.
- Leonardo AI — 4.0/5 — Best free image generator. 150 tokens/day free. Best for budget creators.
- Ideogram — 3.7/5 — Best text rendering in images. Free 10 images/day. Best for text-heavy images.
- Adobe Firefly — 3.6/5 — Only commercially safe generator. 25 free credits. Best for licensed commercial use.
- Stable Diffusion — 3.5/5 — Open-source, free unlimited. Requires 8GB+ GPU. Best for technical users.

### Video & Audio
- ElevenLabs — 4.3/5 — Best AI voice quality. $5/mo (≈₹465). Best for audiobooks and podcasts.
- Runway ML — 4.1/5 — Best AI video quality. $15/mo (≈₹1,395). Best for professional video.
- Descript — 4.0/5 — Edit video by editing text. $24/mo (≈₹2,232). Best for podcasters.
- Pika — 3.7/5 — Budget AI video. $10/mo (≈₹930). Best for cost-conscious creators.
- HeyGen — 3.5/5 — AI avatar videos. $29/mo (≈₹2,697). Best for talking-head content.
- Kling AI — 3.5/5 — Longest video duration. $5.99/mo (≈₹557). Cheapest paid video AI.
- Luma Dream Machine — 3.6/5 — 3D spatial video. Free 30 gen/month. Best for depth/parallax.
- Murf AI — 3.4/5 — Budget voice generation. $19/mo (≈₹1,767). Best for basic voiceovers.
- Stable Video Diffusion — 2.8/5 — Open-source video. Free but requires 12GB+ GPU.
- Otter.ai — 3.8/5 — Meeting transcription. Free 300 min/month. Best for meeting notes.

### Research & Education
